title: Judge retained declared bindings when a present trace has no usable command owner
outcome: A declared foreground row with an original binding does not retain an exit-only verdict merely because an unrelated, stale or unusable trace object is present.
acceptance: A deterministic case covers a present trace rejected for generation/provenance or lacking the command's declared owner, while the original row still retains its binding.

The chosen behavior preserves original execution ownership, never reconstructs a binding from current files, and applies an artifact-aware verdict or an explicit UNKNOWN; no verification authority is added.
